notes.title: Update ver0.1.20 Released! Enhanced Expression: Rim Light, Outline, and Eye Glow
notes.notes:
Thank you so much for using my app!
[p align="start"]I’ve just released Update (ver0.1.20)!

　　
✨ Your characters can now express even more!
Rim Light: When you match the color to the background, your character stands out with more depth and presence.

Outline: Make it thinner for a delicate look, or thicker for a bold, illustration-like style.

Eye Glow: Link it with stage lighting or background colors to create a more dramatic and striking effect.
[p align="start"]　　
[p align="start"]By adjusting these settings to match your MV’s theme or stage, you can create an atmosphere that feels like an entirely new work. Please give it a try and enjoy finding your own style of expression!
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]　　
[p align="start"]📂 How to Access in the App Advanced Settings ＞ Avatar Settings (Individual) ＞ Rim Light / Outline / Emission
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]　　
[p align="start"]I’ll keep improving the app based on your feedback, so it becomes easier and more fun to use.
[p align="start"]Your ratings and reviews encourage me a lot—thank you for your support!
[p align="start"]I hope you’ll continue to enjoy what’s coming next!

notes.title: Update ver0.1.16 Released!
notes.notes:
Thank you for always using the app.   

I've just released an update (ver0.1.16)!  

　
Update Details

✨ Customize the Sky Color Freely!
You can now set the sky to any color using a color palette.
Create the perfect atmosphere for your MV with more flexibility!

　　
🎥 More Background Colors for Chroma Key
In addition to the classic green screen, you can now choose from multiple background colors for chroma key compositing.
This makes it easier to match your video style and setup.
Note: Filters are disabled in chroma key mode, so please adjust the lighting settings if your model appears too dark.

　　
💾 Choose Where to Save Your Videos
You can now freely select the save location for your recordings, making file management much easier.

　　
🎵 MV Auto-Ends When Music Ends
MV playback will now automatically stop when the music ends.
Please note that silent parts of the track are still counted as “playing,” so long silences will delay the ending.

　　
🛠 Other Improvements
Fixed a bug where disabling all preset dances made playback impossible

Fixed UI alignment issues

Slightly adjusted the length and transition timing of the "Idol" preset dance



　

I’m continuously improving the app based on the feedback I receive from users like you.
Thank you again for your support, and I hope you enjoy this update!

notes.title: Update ver0.1.15 Released!
notes.notes:
Thank you for always using the app.   

I've just released an update (ver0.1.15)!  

　
Update Details



🎨 More Advanced Filter Controls
New advanced color adjustment features have been added under \[Advanced Filters] in the \[Detailed Settings] menu.

These allow for fine-tuned control over color tones, making it easier to craft the exact mood you want for your MV.

　
✨ Filter Presets Added
Seven easy-to-use filter presets are now available!

If you're not sure where to start, these presets can help you quickly achieve your ideal visual style — perfect for beginners too.



　
💃 5 New Idol-Style Preset Dances
Five lively and stylish motion presets, designed to match songs at BPM 128, have been added.

If these new motions are well received, I'll consider adding more in future updates!

　

💡 In the future, as more BPM 128 dance motions become available,

I'm also considering a feature that automatically adjusts the playback speed of motions to match the tempo of the music.

This would help create an even more synchronized and immersive MV experience.

　
🛠 Other Improvements
The depth of field effect is now disabled by default for easier usability.

Fixed an issue where the model's position would shift automatically during MV playback.

　

I’m continuously improving the app based on the feedback I receive from users like you.
Thank you again for your support, and I hope you enjoy this update!

notes.title: Update ver0.1.13 Released!
notes.notes:
Thank you for always using the app.   

I've just released an update (ver0.1.13)!  

　
Update Details



🗂 GLB Stage Import Support
You can now import GLB-format stage data using the "Import" button on the stage selection screen.
Bring in your favorite 3D stages and enjoy more creative freedom in your performances!

　
✨ New Effect Feature: Bloom
I've added a bloom effect as the first step in expanding visual filters.
Currently, only the bloom filter is available, but I plan to add more filters in future updates—stay tuned!

　
🎛 UI Button Layout Overhaul
In preparation for future features, I’ve reorganized the button layout significantly.
Now, hovering your cursor over the left edge of the screen will display the settings menu.

　
🔴 Other Improvements
When the recording feature is enabled, the play button at the bottom right will now turn red (instead of the usual blue), making it easy to see whether recording is active.

　

I’m continuously improving the app based on the feedback I receive from users like you.
Thank you again for your support, and I hope you enjoy this update!

notes.title: Update ver0.1.12 Released!
notes.notes:
Thank you for always using the app.  
I've just released an update (ver0.1.12)!

Update Details

Added Controls for Model Position, Rotation, and Scale
I've added a display panel for model position, rotation, and scale settings at the top left of the home screen.  
You can adjust the values by either entering numbers or dragging on the X, Y, Z text labels in the panel.  
Additionally, for position adjustments, you can also drag the bar located at the model’s feet.

Changed Camera Rotation Behavior When Right-Dragging
Previously, right-dragging rotated the camera itself.  
Now, it has been updated to rotate around the model instead.

Other Updates
Fixed UI layout issues that occurred in vertical screen orientation.

I'll continue improving the app based on your feedback to make it as useful as possible.  
Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: Update ver0.1.10 Released!
notes.notes:
Thank you so much for using my app!
I've just released an update (ver0.1.10)!

What's New

Fixed Camera Mode
You can now disable automatic camera work by turning on the switch at the bottom right of the home screen.
You’re free to set the camera position wherever you like.
Fixed Camera Controls
When using fixed camera mode, you can move the camera with the arrow keys.
The camera will automatically return to its original position after movement.
　↑ key: Move forward
　↓ key: Move backward
　← key: Move left
　→ key: Move right
　Shift + ↑ key: Move upward
　Shift + ↓ key: Move downward
Improved stability for rotating camera movements
Adjusted when the avatar menu appears

I'll keep improving the app based on your feedback.
Thanks again for your support—I really appreciate it!
